name: Davidson Fabricating, Inc.
description: A Chester County metal fabrication and construction shop building custom steel and metal work.

hero.headline: Davidson Fabricating, Inc.

items: Custom metal fabrication built to project specs
Structural steel work for commercial and residential jobs
Serving Chester County and the surrounding region
Custom work built to exact project specifications
Straightforward quotes before any fabrication starts
Experience across both commercial and residential jobs

story.heading: About
paragraphs: Davidson Fabricating builds the steel and metal work other contractors design around -- railings, structural pieces, and custom fabrication.
Every job starts with a spec review, so the finished piece matches the plan the first time.

items: Bring in a spec or a sketch and get a straightforward fabrication quote.
Work is built to the exact dimensions and finish called for in the job.
On-site installation is handled by the same shop that fabricated the piece.

feature.heading: Built to spec, not guessed at
feature.text: Every fabrication job starts with the drawings, not a rough estimate -- so the finished piece fits the first time.

spotlight.heading: Structural and custom metal work
spotlight.text: From structural steel to custom railings, the shop handles fabrication and installation start to finish.
